edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer sender, so caller controls the funding source of the transfer
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer routine
msg.sender is used as spender when reducing the allowance in transferFrom
_transfer compares _msgSender() against the router and pair to gate swaps, caller-influenced authorization
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress
_transfer applies fee decision then calls _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer forwards the accounting to _transferStandard
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when swap conditions are met
swapTokensForEth sends the token amount to the external router swap call
The external router swap re-enters the token's transfer logic while inSwap state is being manipulated
_transfer calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance
Local contract ETH balance is passed as the amount argument to sendETHToFee
Local contract token balance is passed as tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to the team address
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to the marketing address
External ETH send to the team wallet can re-enter the distribution path if the recipient is a contract
External ETH send to the marketing wallet can re-enter the distribution path if the recipient is a contract
startTrading calls the factory createPair and stores the result as the pair
startTrading passes the whole contract ETH balance into addLiquidityETH
addLiquidityETH mints LP tokens and can invoke token transfer logic during the pair interaction
startTrading assigns the router address state variable
startTrading assigns the pair address state variable
startTrading enables automatic swapping
startTrading flips the trading open flag
startTrading disables the cooldown flag
startTrading rewrites the max transaction amount
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the contract balance
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance
blockBots writes true into the bots mapping for each address
unblockBot clears the bots mapping entry for an address
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldown state variable
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount with mul and div on the total supply
renounceOwnership sets the owner state variable to the zero address
Constructor initializes the owner from msg.sender
Constructor sets the team fee address
Constructor sets the marketing fee address
Constructor marks several addresses as excluded from fees
Cooldown mapping is read and written with block.timestamp inside _transfer
block.timestamp enforces the 30 second buy cooldown, a miner-influenced dependency
block.timestamp is used directly as the router swap deadline
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline
_transferStandard reads and writes the reflection balances of sender and recipient
transferFrom reads and reduces the allowance mapping
approve writes into the allowance mapping via _approve
_transfer checks fee exclusion for sender and recipient
_transfer enforces the maximum transaction amount
_transfer rejects transfers involving blocked bot addresses
Tax fee is used to compute reflection fees
Team fee is used to compute the team token portion
inSwap flag acts as the swap reentrancy guard and is cleared after the lockTheSwap modifier body
Total token supply bounds the liquidity amount and max transaction computations
